content: आसत्तिः {%f.%} [आ-सद्-क्तिन्] .²1 Meeting, junction. .²2 Intimate union, nearness, close contact; किमपि किमपि मन्दं मन्दमासत्तियोगात् <ls>U. 1. 27</ls>. .²3 Gain, profit, acquirement. .²4 (In Logic) Proximity, the absence of interruption in the apprehension of what is said; relation between two or more proximate terms and the sense conveyed by them; कारणं सन्निधानं तु पदस्यासत्तिरुच्यते <ls>Bhāṣā P. 83</ls>; वाक्यं स्याद् योग्यताकाङ्क्षासत्तियुक्तः पदोच्चयः <ls>S. D. 2</ls>. .²5 Embarrassment, perplexity; न च ते क्वचिदासत्तिर्बुद्धेः प्रादुर्भविष्यति <ls>Mb. 12. 52. 17</ls>.
